name: intuneRestrictUserDeviceJoin
label: Configure user restriction for Entra device join
helpText: Controls whether users can join devices to Entra: no users, all users, or only members of selected groups. Tenants where Entra reports this setting as not admin-configurable are reported but not written to.
executiveText: Controls whether employees can join their devices to the corporate Entra directory. Disabling user device join prevents unauthorized or unmanaged devices from becoming corporate-managed identities, enhancing overall security posture.
docsDescription: Configures whether users can join devices to Entra. With selected groups, only members of the listed groups (comma-separated names or IDs, custom variables including list variables allowed) can join, and the group list is graded against the tenant by ID. When disabled, users are unable to Entra-join devices, which prevents them from creating new Entra-joined (cloud-managed) device identities.

allowedToJoin.label: Users allowed to join devices to Entra

options.label: No users (disable users from joining devices)

allowedToJoinGroups.label: Groups allowed to join devices
allowedToJoinGroups.helperText: Comma-separated group names or IDs. Custom variables work too, including list variables such as %DeviceJoinGroups%.
